identity.question: Will Lionel Messi finish in the top 3 of the 2026 Ballon d’Or?

scope: Facts for Ballon d’Or 2026 window 2025-08-03–2026-07-19. No forecasts, ranking, or market action.

facts.claim: FIFA page-discovery leads report Messi 8 goals/4 assists/853 minutes; Rodri Golden Ball, Messi Silver Ball and Silver Boot, Mbappé Golden Boot; and Argentina lost the final 1-0 to Spain. These are unverified here: FIFA page bodies were app shells and browser-open returned zero lines.

MLS Messi match-log endpoint returned a 200 HTML shell without match rows; no date-bounded club aggregate was calculated. Full-year totals would not isolate the contract window; October 2026 stats and October 6 farewell are out of scope.

UEFA 2025/26 UCL: Mbappé 15 goals (top scorer), Kane 14, Kvaratskhelia 10, Dembélé 8; Olise and Vinícius tied for most assists (8); Vitinha recorded a hat-trick. UEFA named Kvaratskhelia Player of the Season (16 apps, 10 goals, 6 assists); Paris won a second consecutive title and Dembélé scored the final equalizer.

Kane totals are season aggregates, not event-level window-filtered.
